verdict.rationale: LibreChat ships a beta Agent Management API covering agent create/discover/update/delete, agent files, Skills, and machine-client authentication via OIDC, and an OpenAPI spec is published. That is a programmatic surface, but only for a slice of what the UI does. Nothing shows UI-equivalent API coverage for chatting, conversations, memory, scheduled chats, search, import, or admin configuration; the Admin Panel and Agent Builder are documented as browser workflows. Missing for 10: documented API parity for chat, conversations, memory, scheduled chats, admin config and other UI features; a non-beta API; hands-on confirmation of API completeness.
